name: South Bay Galleria
description: South Bay Galleria is a premier three-level regional shopping destination in Redondo Beach featuring over 140 retailers including anchor stores Macy's and Kohl's, plus an AMC Dine-In Theatre with 16 screens. The mall offers a comprehensive shopping and entertainment experience with diverse dining options, special events, and seasonal attractions including Santa photos, gift wrapping services, and holiday entertainment.
demographics: Serving South Bay communities including Redondo Beach, North Redondo, South Redondo, and surrounding Beach Cities with a family-oriented customer base seeking shopping, dining, and entertainment options.
summary: A three-level regional mall in Redondo Beach's South Bay area offering 140+ retailers, department store anchors, AMC Theatre, and family-friendly dining and entertainment.
